prompt: who made the first commercially available robotic vacume cleaner for cleaning floors at home? Was it xiami
judge_reasoning: The prompt asks for the maker of the first commercially available robotic vacuum and whether it was Xiaomi. Candidates 1 and 4 both correctly identify the Electrolux Trilobite (1996) as the earliest credited commercial robotic vacuum, while omitting an explicit “not Xiaomi” statement. Candidate 2 gives a clearly incorrect attribution to ECOVAC and an implausible 1996 inventorship detail. Candidate 3 is heavily muddled and includes multiple questionable/incorrect model attributions, so it is far less faithful to the specific “first commercially available” identification.
